FAQ

Your questions, answered

How much does a website or an app cost?

A showcase site starts around €2,900, a mobile app beyond €14,900. Every project is unique, so we provide a detailed, no-surprise quote after a free first call.

What are your timelines?

Allow 3 to 6 weeks for a showcase site, and 2 to 4 months for a mobile app or web platform. We deliver in sprints, so you see the product from the first weeks.

Do you work with clients outside Paris?

Yes — we work with clients across France and Europe. Our remote processes (weekly demos, shared project tool) make collaboration smooth, wherever you are.

What happens after launch?

Every project includes a warranty period. After that, our maintenance plans cover updates, security, backups and evolutions. You stay in control of your product.

Custom code or no-code?

We build custom solutions with modern technologies (Next.js, React Native...). That guarantees performance, code ownership and freedom from proprietary platforms. On tight budgets, we can also recommend a suitable no-code solution.
